content.comment_body: Hello all, I'm working on a project where I'm measuring temperature (range 20-100°C) using a PT100 sensor connected to an [product_name] expansion module for RTD inputs. There's also another [product_name] expansion module installed, which provides a 1-10V analog control output based on temperature readings. The goal is to send this control voltage to the inverter's analog input, as the inverter uses its own PID to regulate cooling fans. I've followed the wiring instructions according to the inverter's 0-10V analog input pinout (shown in the attached image), but I'm unsure about my setup. Any advice or guidance on achieving a reliable connection is appreciated.

Hi [user_name], please avoid posting duplicate questions. You already created another topic with the same issue (connecting [product_name] output to inverter analog input), where you'll find the response you need.

Thread closed due to duplicate posts. The other discussion titled 'Connecting [product_name] to inverter analog input' is available in the [product_name] hardware section. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator
